events.detail: Observed 41 stale closed PRs from the May 2026 cleanup, 9 of which carried potentially useful work (docs, skills, CI hardening).
Retrieved docs/stale-pr-salvage-ledger.md rows, prior maintainer salvage PRs (#1720-#1782), current catalog counts, and translator/manual-review flags on localization PRs.
Proposed two candidates: a maintainer-owned salvage branch with attribution ('maintainer-salvage-branch') and a wholesale cherry-pick of stale translation updates ('blind-cherry-pick-translations').
Verifier checked attribution, privacy, localization risk, ledger updates, and validation gates for both candidates; the blind cherry-pick failed translator/manual review and stale-count checks.
Promoted 'maintainer-salvage-branch' as the only playbook; release publication remains approval-gated and unrelated localization stays blocked pending review.
